name: Whitepages

search.notes: Pattern from auto-identity-remove. The site served a bot challenge on 2026-10-27 so it was not confirmed.

steps: Find the listing and copy its URL.
Open the suppression request page and paste the URL.
Confirm the record, pick a reason and enter a working phone number.
Answer the automated call and enter the code shown on screen. The person must do this step.
Repeat for 411.com, which uses the same data but a separate opt-out.
optout.notes: Prior-art sources disagree. identity-eraser describes a phone call with an on-screen code, nulltrace records a captcha and an email confirmation. Expect either.

sources.attribution: California Privacy Protection Agency data broker registry, 2026 list fetched 2026-10-27
